verdict.rationale: Datadog's own docs confirm a full API Reference plus dedicated Dashboards and Monitors documentation, implying dashboards/monitors can be created and managed programmatically (JSON/API), which is the foundation for infrastructure-as-code workflows. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of a Terraform provider, dashboard JSON export/import workflow, or CI/CD provisioning examples, so the 'as code, repeatable provisioning' claim is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit Terraform provider documentation, dashboard-as-code JSON schema examples, and independent/hands-on confirmation of repeatable provisioning workflows.
